book_free_structural_finding.test: centre-normalise every scenario cell so B0 cancels entirely, then fit a SINGLE GLOBAL (b,c). No book value enters, so the source-date objection cannot reach it.

what_survives_the_correction.single_global_bc_suffices_for_SHAPE: on the book-free test a single global (b,c) passes both gates. Per-index fitting was needed only for LEVELS. That localises the whole remaining problem to B0.
